d:
The story of a mysterious young man who in order to relieve himself of what he see's as a curse of incorporeality, pledges himself to the Outer God Nyarlathotep and sent to spread chaos and corruption in the universes beyond the dream, a journey he will take under the watchful eye of the Hammer of Crawling Chaos, the Corrupted Kara-Zor L, however could this be the freedom the Acolyte wished for all his life, or did he just exchange one curse for another.

A spin off of the comic JL Forsaken Souls

Written by DanteCrysis with Illustrations by Ganassa

Uploads on the 6th of the Month.

Stand alone colour illustrations are released on the 10th of every month, 2 months after initial release
